text: My husband suddenly collapsed to the floor and is not responding. He is gasping for air and his lips are turning blue.
My daughter ate a peanut cookie and now she cannot breathe, her throat is closing up, face is swollen and she is wheezing loudly.
Patient was found completely unconscious with shallow breathing and a deep bleeding arterial wound on his neck that won't stop bleeding.
He has been having a continuous generalized tonic-clonic seizure for over eight minutes without waking up and is now gasping.
My roommate is slumped on the couch, completely non-responsive, with pinpoint pupils and breathing only three times a minute after suspected drug overdose.
Construction worker caught in industrial machinery with complete traumatic amputation of the right leg above knee and massive spurting hemorrhage.
Patient brought in after near drowning at the community pool, pulseless and non-breathing, CPR in progress by bystanders.
Severe gunshot wound to the right hemithorax with absent breath sounds on the right, tracheal deviation to the left, and profound hypotension.
Diabetic patient found unresponsive in bed with glucometer reading unmeasurably low, diaphoretic, seizing, and unresponsive to painful stimuli.
Patient pulled from burning house with third-degree circumferential burns over 60 percent of body surface area, soot in oropharynx, and severe inspiratory stridor.
Patient presenting with massive hematemesis, vomiting two liters of bright red blood in triage, blood pressure 60/40, pulse 140, rapidly losing consciousness.
Patient choking on a piece of steak at dinner, holding hands to throat, making silent gasping attempts, unable to speak, cough, or breathe, and turning pale blue.
Pediatric patient found submerged in bathtub for unknown duration, cyanotic, flaccid, apnea with heart rate 40 beats per minute.
Elderly patient found on floor after carbon monoxide leak, unarousable with decerebrate posturing and profound respiratory depression.
Trauma patient ejected from vehicle rollover at high speed, non-responsive with flail chest, paradoxical respirations, and barely palpable carotid pulse.
I am having severe crushing chest pain that feels like an elephant sitting on my chest, with radiating pain down my left arm and cold sweat.
My mother suddenly developed slurred speech twenty minutes ago and has weakness and numbness on the right side of her body and face.
I have the sudden severe worst headache of my life that came on like a thunderclap, along with a stiff neck and vomiting.
I started vomiting large amounts of dark red blood and blood clots about an hour ago and I feel very dizzy and faint when standing.
I have severe 10/10 tearing abdominal and back pain that started abruptly, and my abdomen feels hard as a rock.
Patient states: I took a large overdose of sleeping pills and blood pressure pills two hours ago and I feel completely hopeless.
I was struck in the head with a baseball bat, lost consciousness for five minutes, and now I have clear fluid leaking from my nose and confusion.
26F who is 8 weeks pregnant presents with sudden severe sharp right lower quadrant pelvic pain, vaginal spotting, and syncope.
Known asthmatic presents with acute severe breathlessness, unable to speak more than one word at a time, using sternocleidomastoid accessory muscles.
16M presents with sudden onset of severe excruciating right testicular pain and swelling that began 90 minutes ago, accompanied by nausea.
52F presents with severe sudden ocular pain, rainbow halos around lights, cloudy steamy cornea, fixed mid-dilated pupil, and severe nausea.
Cancer patient undergoing active chemotherapy presents with high fever of 103.5F, rigors, heart rate 125, and feeling dizzy.
34F with history of deep vein thrombosis presents with sudden sharp pleuritic chest pain, coughing up blood, acute dyspnea, and tachycardia of 130.
Industrial laboratory worker had concentrated sodium hydroxide alkali chemical splashed directly into both eyes five minutes ago, experiencing blinding pain.
Patient with known Type 1 diabetes presents with deep rapid Kussmaul respirations, fruity breath odor, persistent vomiting, and confusion.
42M presents with sudden painless loss of vision in the left eye described as a dark curtain descending over his visual field.
Patient on high-dose Warfarin anticoagulation therapy presents with massive spontaneous epistaxis filling cups with blood that will not stop bleeding.
Young adult brought in by family after sending goodbye messages, found sitting with a loaded firearm and expressing active desire to end their life.
60M with chronic aortic aneurysm presents with tearing mid-scapular interscapular back pain, asymmetric blood pressure between arms, and diaphoresis.
Patient with neck swelling after dental extraction has severe difficulty swallowing, drooling, muffled hot-potato voice, and anterior neck erythema.
I have had moderate crampy right lower quadrant abdominal pain for 12 hours with mild nausea and low-grade temperature of 99.8F.
I slipped on ice and hurt my left wrist. It is painful and swollen, but my fingers are warm and pink with normal sensation.
I have had a productive cough with yellowish phlegm and feeling feverish for 3 days. My oxygen level on my home meter is 96 percent.
I have had burning pain when urinating along with dull right lower back ache for two days. No vomiting and no high fever.
48F presents with colicky right upper quadrant abdominal pain that radiates to right shoulder blade after eating fried chicken 3 hours ago, accompanied by nausea.
55M presents with acute left flank pain radiating to left groin with gross hematuria, pacing the room in discomfort, vital signs normal.
62M presents with persistent left lower quadrant pain and constipation for 4 days, low-grade temperature 100.2F, no peritoneal signs.
38F presents with 3 days of unilateral right calf pain and swelling after an 8-hour airplane flight, unable to comfortably bear weight.
Patient with history of moderate asthma has worsening wheezing and chest tightness after catching a cold, oxygen saturation 95% on room air.
70M presents with acute painful urinary retention, unable to void for 10 hours, suprapubic fullness and moderate distress.
29M presents with worsening painful swelling and redness on his right buttock for 3 days, fluctuant 4cm tender mass, temperature 99.1F.
Patient presents with persistent vomiting and diarrhea for 24 hours from viral gastroenteritis, feeling dizzy when standing, pulse 98, BP 110/70.
Patient with established chronic sickle cell disease presents with typical moderate vaso-occlusive bone pain in bilateral humeri and thighs, baseline vitals.
65F presents with sudden onset of room-spinning vertigo that worsens when turning head to left, with nausea and horizontal nystagmus, normal gait.
50M presents with expanding area of warmth, erythema, and tenderness on left anterior shin for 2 days without bullae or systemic signs.
I accidentally cut my left thumb with a clean kitchen knife while slicing bread. The bleeding stopped after direct pressure, but the cut is open about 1.5 cm.
I twisted my ankle playing basketball yesterday. It is mildly swollen on the outer ankle, but I am able to put weight on it and walk.
My right eye has been itchy, pink, and watery for two days with clear drainage. My vision is completely normal and I have no eye pain.
I have an itchy red localized rash on my right forearm after gardening near poison ivy. No facial swelling, no breathing problems.
I have had a mild sore throat, clear runny nose, and sneezing for two days. No difficulty swallowing and no fever.
24F presents with dysuria and increased urinary frequency for 24 hours, afebrile, no back or flank pain, denies nausea.
7-year-old child with acute left earache that began last night, pulling at ear, mild fever 99.5F, alert and playful in triage.
Carpenter got a wooden splinter embedded deep under the fingernail of his index finger 3 hours ago, unable to extract at home.
Patient presents with painful red swelling beside the cuticle of right thumb for 2 days after hangnail trimming, small white pustule visible.
Gardener scratched cornea on a rose bush branch 4 hours ago, foreign body sensation and photophobia, visual acuity 20/25.
Patient jammed left middle finger catching a basketball, mildly swollen proximal interphalangeal joint, good range of motion, no skin break.
Adult presents with superficial second-degree burn the size of a quarter on forearm after hot soup splash, small intact blister.
Patient presents with painful swelling in mouth under tongue after meals, small firm movable white calculus visible at submandibular duct.
I ran out of my monthly blood pressure and cholesterol medications yesterday and need a routine refill prescription from a doctor. Feeling completely fine.
I had five stitches put in my forearm ten days ago at urgent care. The wound is completely healed and I am here to have the sutures removed.
I have a small dry patch of skin on my right elbow that has been slightly itchy for over a month. No pain, no bleeding, no fever.
I need a routine pre-employment physical exam and medical clearance form signed for my new job.
I have had mild lower back stiffness in the mornings for several months that improves with gentle stretching. No numbness, weakness, or leg pain.
Patient presents asking for an update to their tetanus vaccination after cleaning up yard waste, no cuts, punctures, or wounds present.
Patient noticed an engorged tick on their pant leg after walking in woods today, tick was brushed off, no bite mark, no rash, completely asymptomatic.
Patient presents asking for doctor's sick leave note for employer after missing work yesterday due to mild hangover, currently asymptomatic.
Patient presents with long-standing mild toe fungus on two toenails for six months, asking what over-the-counter polish to use.
Patient requests clean sterile gauze and medical tape to re-wrap a clean healing superficial scratch on forearm.
College student requests routine tuberculosis PPD skin test reading 48 hours after placement, forearm is completely flat with zero induration.
Patient requesting blood pressure check on their way to the pharmacy, states they feel fine and their home machine showed 124/82.
45-year-old male was found in garage with car running, completely unresponsive with cherry-red skin, gasping agonal respirations, and unmeasurable SpO2.
12-year-old boy stung by multiple bees at camp, collapsed in anaphylactic shock, audible inspiratory stridor, profound cyanosis, and impalpable radial pulses.
Pediatric toddler seized continuously for 20 minutes at daycare, remains flaccid and unresponsive with shallow irregular breathing and cyanotic extremities.
Construction worker fell four stories, non-responsive, massive open cranial vault trauma with exposed brain matter and agonal breathing.
Elderly female with history of heart failure collapsed in church, pulseless, bystander CPR initiated with automated external defibrillator advising shock.
Patient with known severe depression ingested an entire bottle of potassium chloride and tricyclic antidepressants, unresponsive with widening QRS on monitor and severe hypotension.
Motorcycle crash victim with complete traumatic transection of femoral artery, blood pooling rapidly on stretcher, systolic BP 55 mmHg, pulse 150.
Child swallowed a coin, completely unable to cough or breathe, making silent clutching gestures at neck and turning dark purple.
Patient with end-stage renal disease missed dialysis for two weeks, found unresponsive with profound bradycardia of 22 bpm and peaked T waves on rhythm strip.
Swimmer pulled from ocean surf, apneic and pulseless with frothy pink sputum emerging from mouth and nose.
Industrial burn victim with high-voltage electrical contact, entrance and exit wounds, entry into sustained ventricular tachycardia with loss of consciousness.
Severe motor vehicle collision victim with bilateral open tension pneumothoraces, massive subcutaneous emphysema, absent bilateral breath sounds, and unmeasurable BP.
64-year-old male with diabetes reports sudden heavy crushing retrosternal chest tightness, feeling dizzy, and profuse diaphoresis that started 40 minutes ago.
58-year-old female presents with acute onset of right facial droop, right arm paralysis, and inability to speak coherent words starting 35 minutes ago.
31-year-old female presents with sudden explosive worst headache of her life accompanied by neck stiffness, photophobia, and projectile vomiting.
72-year-old male on Eliquis anticoagulation therapy presents with massive coughing up of bright red blood, filled two emesis basins, feeling lightheaded.
24-year-old female with positive home pregnancy test has sudden severe agonizing lower abdominal pain, shoulder pain, and passed out in the bathroom.
19-year-old male reports acute onset of excruciating left scrotal pain 2 hours ago with swelling, nausea, and absent cremasteric reflex.
61-year-old male with chronic hypertension has severe tearing substernal chest pain radiating between shoulder blades with blood pressure 210/115 in right arm and 140/85 in left arm.
45-year-old female presents with acute severe eye pain, halos around lights, cloudy cornea, fixed dilated pupil, and severe frontal headache.
Chemotherapy patient for lymphoma has fever of 103.8F, shaking rigors, heart rate 130 bpm, blood pressure 85/50, and extreme fatigue.
Young adult brought in by police after texting family a suicide note, found sitting on a bridge with intent to jump and expressing active hopelessness.
Industrial worker splashed concentrated battery acid into both eyes 10 minutes ago, severe chemosis, extreme blepharospasm, and screaming in pain.
Patient with known Type 1 diabetes has fruity acetone breath, deep rapid Kussmaul respirations, glucose 650 mg/dL, and extreme lethargy.
35-year-old female with sudden shortness of breath, pleuritic chest pain, heart rate 128 bpm, and unilateral left lower leg swelling following recent oral contraceptive use.
